findings.problem: Accurate damped steps inside the 0.9-to-1 radius tolerance could not enlarge the trust region.
findings.fix: Use the radius solver tolerance for regularized steps; retain the dogleg boundary rule.

findings.problem: Clipping outward coupled Newton coordinates at active bounds left other coordinates solving an incompatible model.
findings.fix: Resolve the remaining Jacobian columns at active bounds without new optical calls; retain measured decrease and Cauchy fallback.

findings.problem: A blocking startup wait occupied an xUnit pool worker and cleanup could dispose callback gates before the queued optimization stopped.
findings.fix: Await startup with the original 5-second limit, cancel and drain before disposing; retain the two-second independent lock probe and stale-result assertions.

findings.problem: Geometry DTO record equality compared dictionary references, breaking unchanged prescription comparisons across rollback and undo.
findings.fix: Use exact ordinal kind/key and numeric value equality with insertion-order-independent hashing; retain immutable copies.

Early one-coordinate radius regression did not expose the damped-step defect because it selected the boundary Cauchy step. The final anisotropic regression fails on the original solver.
The initial new KKT regression over-specified Stationary termination; its final contract checks the constrained solution and independent KKT signs and accepts numerical StepTooSmall termination.

The v19 recovery regression required this difficult start to fail. v20 meets its original 800-evaluation specification. The regression now requires acceptance, checks the independently recomputed original gates and separately rejects the same optic against a tighter 0.001 mm RMS limit.
